fire_active_coverage_localization.cause: The Fire profile resolver correctly rejects otherwise legal spells during the native global cooldown, but when every candidate is rejected it discards the candidate spell identity and returns no_valid_profile_action with spell_id zero. RecordCombatAttempt therefore cannot observe HasGlobalCooldown and publishes no_action instead of the scheduling result global_cooldown. The one-second alternating cadence and exact 1007 ms median establish that 52 of 60 non-casting no-action rows are scheduler waits, not missing rotation activity. The audit threshold is correct; the runtime diagnostic classification is not.

fire_cast_failure_localization.cause: Every failure has known, cooldown, power, range, line-of-sight, alive, and attackability gates true, while core result 150 is emitted by caster-control mechanics. ResolveProfileCombatAction already rejects UNIT_STATE_CONTROLLED, but the hostile executor repeats no controlled-state preflight, leaving a same-tick race between resolution and CastSpell during the Corborus and Azil control waves. This is a real rejected submission, not an audit mismatch.

protection_retention_localization.cause: At 16 hostiles the Protection tank briefly owns the complete Corborus wave, but that ownership comes from emergency taunt/protection control and lacks the existing 2000-threat and 2.5x headroom definition of secure. The addCount >= 12 urgent release bypass immediately unlocks party AoE; one second later ownership is 8 of 17 and then 1 of 10 while the tank crosses to the loose cluster. Generation 2 contributes 68 of 167 missing samples. Raising only the urgent release size above the observed 20-hostile Corborus burst, while remaining below the previously proven 30-hostile runaway boundary, restores the existing secure-headroom gate for this wave without changing retention acceptance.

protection_exposure_localization.cause: Four eligible corridor hostiles remain healer-owned while Protection serially submits its existing native pickup chain. The chain keeps every identity below the unchanged dwell ceiling but still contributes 28 of 37 exposed samples. The boss-add controller already uses native Hand of Protection when at least five attackers hit the healer; applying the same emergency protection at three ordinary-trash attackers removes healer victim ownership before the serial threat recovery without changing any audit gate.

accepted_causal_chain: Rerun157 canary 2 independently passed every strict route, identity, retention, exposure/dwell, role, publication, cleanup, and eviction gate before canary 3 was unlocked.

Canary 3 retained the exact rerun157 process, epoch, profile, planned party, serial isolation, remote publication, cleanup, and local payload eviction contracts and completed all 14 route terminals and four real bosses.
Independent capture validation and exact role-audit replay reproduced all four published failure labels.
Fire active coverage is understated because 52 one-second post-cast global-cooldown waits lose spell identity and are recorded as no_action; the strict 0.8 threshold remains unchanged.
All eight Fire cast failures are genuine Living Bomb submissions rejected by a caster control mechanic across the two scripted add waves.
Protection's 16-hostile Corborus wave bypasses the existing secure threat-headroom release gate and contributes 68 of 167 missing ownership samples.
Four initial corridor hostiles contribute 28 of 37 healer-target samples while the native Protection pickup chain remains inside the strict dwell ceiling.
The serial operator correctly stopped after canary 3; canaries 4 through 8 and Phases 10 through 12 remain blocked.

smallest_safe_corrections.change: When no action is selected but at least one otherwise legal candidate is rejected only by global cooldown, preserve global_cooldown as the invalid-action reason and record/return BotActionResult::GlobalCooldown instead of NoAction. Do not change candidate eligibility or the role-audit threshold.

Repeat the existing UNIT_STATE_CONTROLLED preflight immediately before hostile spell submission and return the existing scheduling result throttled while the caster cannot act. Preserve every native spell and target legality check.

smallest_safe_corrections.scope: Protection threat retention and healer protection
smallest_safe_corrections.change: Raise only the urgent large-wave DPS release boundary from 12 to 24 hostiles so the observed 16-20 hostile bursts retain the existing 2000-threat/2.5x secure gate, and use native Hand of Protection before the ordinary-trash pickup chain when at least three attackers target the healer.
